=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/claude_checker_restart.py: 302-322 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: load_trigger_pages takes has_more only from the last supplied page, so an omitted intermediate page followed by a terminal page can make an incomplete trigger listing appear complete and allow an unsafe checker restart.
  WHY: decide may then fail to see a pending trigger on the omitted page; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, and google_gemini-3_8-flash rate this MAJOR, while z-ai_glm-5_2 rates it NIT and describes shipped-flow runtime risk as low.
- scripts/claude_checker_restart.py: 312 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: An empty paths list returns has_more=False, which can be interpreted as a complete listing with zero triggers.
  WHY: The current argparse entry point requires --triggers-file and passes a non-empty list, so this is only reachable through a direct Python call.
- tests/test_claude_checker_restart.py: test_trigger_pages_join_and_take_has_more_from_the_last_page (lines ~888-911) | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The test does not cover an omitted middle page followed by a terminal page with has_more=False.
  WHY: The uncovered input shape exposes the loader’s incomplete-listing behavior and would catch the missing-middle-page case.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Condition 1 needs the whole list of enabled Routines, so step 1 reads up to 5 `list_triggers` pages of 100 while a page has `has_more`, and step 3b passes each page to `scan`. A listing whose last page still has `has_more` restarts and re-queues nothing."
  expected_change_site: scripts/claude_checker_restart.py — load_trigger_pages
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The loader at lines 310-322 overwrites `has_more` with the last page's value rather than OR-ing or retaining any page's `has_more=True`. The PR description and the docstring both assert the fail-safe for "missing" pages, but the implementation only enforces it when the LAST provided page has `has_more=True`; an omitted middle page followed by a terminal page returns `has_more=False`. The new test at lines 888-911 does not cover this case.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  WHY: An omitted intermediate page or duplicated terminal page can make the listing appear complete, so decide may not see an active project checker’s enabled trigger and may trigger an erroneous restart.

  Expected change site: scripts/claude_checker_restart.py — load_trigger_pages should treat a skipped/omitted intermediate page as a fail-safe violation (has_more=True), matching the docstring's contract claim.

The PR description and the docstring both assert the fail-safe for "missing" pages, but the implementation only enforces it when the LAST provided page has `has_more=True`; an omitted middle page followed by a terminal page returns `has_more=False`. The new test at lines 888-911 does not cover this case.

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/claude_checker_restart.py: 302-322, `load_trigger_pages` | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The loader takes has_more only from the last supplied page and does not verify that the pages are contiguous.
  WHY: If the first and third pages are supplied but the second is omitted, the listing is marked complete and decide can restart a checker despite its pending trigger being on the omitted page.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/claude_checker_restart.py: load_trigger_pages docstring lines 302-308 vs. loop at 313-322 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The docstring claims that a missing, reordered, or repeated page leaves has_more true, but a skipped intermediate page followed by a terminal page with has_more=False returns has_more=False.
  WHY: decide may treat the listing as complete and restart a checker whose pending trigger was on the omitted page 2.
- scripts/claude_checker_restart.py: load_trigger_pages lines 299-322 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The function does not detect or reject a missing intermediate page and does not receive or validate pagination cursors.
  WHY: The script cannot enforce the fail-safe it claims to provide, so missing pages can silently make the listing appear complete.

  WHY: The shipped pickup reads pages contiguously, but a future caller relying on the documented contract could be misled; the test does not cover the missing-intermediate case.
